text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: runtime queueing spike in us-west-2 - 95p latency 8.2s, avg inflight per-GPU 96%, accept rate dropping. Auto-shed triggered but backpressure not stabilizing.

eva-oncall: acked, paging oncall. I'm taking the pager.

alice: on it. initial ask: can we triage customers by tier and reduce concurrency for free/partner tenants? keep paid SLOs if possible.

ben-runtime: quick check, shard runtime-03 shows max_inflight at 200/204, queue length ~22k. I'm preparing a soft increase of max_inflight +20 and a temporary tiered quota change.

dinesh: agree with tiered quota. also recommend disabling non-critical features that add KV cache pressure (embeddings async batching for free-tier).

caroline: what's the rollback plan if increasing max_inflight causes OOM or higher tail latency? need a circuit to revert automatically.

ben-runtime: plan: ramp +20, monitor 1m P95 and free-tier queue growth. if p95 > 10s or OOM alerts, revert to previous value. I'll push a short-lived guard:
```
POST /api/runtime/shards/runtime-03/scale
{ "max_inflight": 220, "note": "emergency - us-west-2" }
```

ben-runtime: executed the scale command, API returned 202 accepted. watching metrics.

incidents-bot: deploy-bot: scale request accepted by autoscaler, rollout id: r-78f3.

alice: going to set tenant concurrency caps: free-tier concurrency -> 2, partner-tier -> 4. Sending command to control plane. This should immediately reduce queue pressure from noisy free callers.

alice: command run: `ffctl set quota.free-tier.max_concurrency 2 --reason "emergency us-west-2"` -> success.

caroline: toggling embeddings async for free-tier now with feature flag: `ffctl set feature.embeddings.async false --target free-tier`

dinesh: monitoring: queue length dropped to 14k, inflight at 85% now, P95 down to 4.6s. No OOM. Good signal.

alice: customer-impact: CS - please notify the following tenants about reduced concurrency and degraded embedding async: acme-inc (paid), learnly (free, high traffic), partner-x (partner). We expect restored SLO for paid but degraded throughput for free tier.

support-bot: opened INC-2026 with summary "us-west-2 runtime queue spike - tiered quota and feature flag mitigations" and assigned to alice + ben + dinesh.

caroline: I'm updating the internal status page + sending short note to #customer-status about affected tenants and ETA for normal ops. ETA 30-45 minutes to monitor stability then roll back feature gates.

ben-runtime: metrics stable for 10m, P95 at 3.2s, inflight ~78%. I'll keep the +20 while we stabilize and make the increase sticky for 1hr. If everything stays green we'll scale back to normal config with a canary.

alice: documented mitigation steps in the incident ticket and will draft a postmortem placeholder. We'll follow up with a root cause analysis (likely traffic pattern + insufficient pre-warm for runtime-03).

eva-oncall: handing off to night oncall @ben-runtime in 15m. If anything regresses, page me immediately.

incidents-bot: :white_check_mark: incident status updated: mitigations applied (tiered quota caps, embeddings async off for free-tier, short max_inflight bump). No customer-facing downtime reported beyond reduced throughput for listed tenants.

caroline: once stable for 30m we'll revert the aggressive flags and run a controlled increases test. Assigning post-incident action item: tune autoscaler pre-warm thresholds and add a low-tier token bucket.

alice: noted. I'll create ACTION-375 on the backlog.

ben-runtime: leaving monitoring dashboard open, will post final notes before midnight handoff.

support-bot: reminder sent to CS: "Affected tenants notified; no request surface change required from customers. Expected return to normal within 45m."

eva-oncall: thanks team. handing off now. :thumbsup:
